mapper.insert: insert into ai_content_review_issue(task_id, issue_code, category, severity, location, description, suggestion, source) values(#{taskId}, #{issueCode}, #{category}, #{severity}, #{location}, #{description}, #{suggestion}, #{source})
mapper.select: select id, task_id, issue_code, category, severity, location, description, suggestion, source from ai_content_review_issue where task_id=#{taskId} order by severity, id
